requirement: Host doors refuse a label that is a path, a job id that walks out of the jobs directory and a body that is not an object, and run a provision or teardown once for two simultaneous requests

oracle.ref: PR #1541 (fix); fix evidence: QA suite: teardown accepted ../../etc and a/b with 202, GET /_host/jobs/..%2Fsecret answered 200 with a file outside the jobs dir, two provisions with one jobKey ran provision.sh twice, null bodies gave 500. The tracy-web half (comments/clear needs {mine:true}; %00/%FF site keys answer 400) is covered by apps/tracy-web/test/site-comments.test.mjs and site-key-encoding.test.mjs, which need TEST_DATABASE_URL and run in CI under ci:integration.
oracle.invariant: S1: the script starts once for each pair and both answers name the same job; every path or flag label is 400 and the real label is 202; the traversal id is 404 and the real job reads; every non-object body is 400, never 500. S2: tracy_require_label accepts the real label; every script exits 2 with 'refused label' on the path label before it builds a path.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
